newsitem.title: USA: Sinclair Broadcast files 5.0 mln "A" shrs.
newsitem.headline: Sinclair Broadcast files 5.0 mln "A" shrs.

text.p: Sinclair Broadcast Group Inc filed Wednesday with the Securities and Exchange Commission for up to 5.0 million class A common shares.
Of the total, 4.0 million shares will be offered in the U.S. and Canada and 1.0 million shares will be sold outside those two countries.

Net proceeds from the offering plus proceeds from an offering of 2.0 million series C preferred shares valued at $200 milion will be used for the repayment of debt under the coompany's bank credit facility, it said.

The offering will be made through a group of underwriters led by Smith Barney Inc. The underwriters have an over-allotment option of up to 750,000 additional class A common shares, according to the filing.
